build_vision_transformer_model: build a VisionTransformer model from a config object with patch embedding and transformer blocks
run_forward_features: run forward_features on video input to extract normalized CLS token embeddings from transformer blocks
run_forward_pass: run the full forward pass through the VisionTransformer to get classification logits or softmax probabilities
reset_classifier_head: reset the classifier head of a VisionTransformer to a new number of classes for transfer learning
review_positional_embedding: review the VisionTransformer positional embedding strategy supporting joint spatiotemporal or separate temporal embeddings
